parsed.name: Cytomat自动化微孔板培养存储系统
parsed.name_en: Cytomat automated microplate incubator storage system
parsed.description: Cytomat是一类自动化微孔板培养与存储设备，可在受控温度、CO2、O2和湿度条件下存放和培养微孔板，并通过内部转运机构在存储位、转运位、等待位和外露位之间移动板件。该设备常用于细胞培养、药物筛选及与实验室自动化平台联用的板库管理。
parsed.description_en: Cytomat is an automated microplate incubation and storage system that stores and incubates plates under controlled temperature, CO2, O2, and humidity conditions, while moving plates between storage, transfer, wait, and exposed positions using an internal handling mechanism. It is commonly used for cell culture, drug screening, and plate storage within laboratory automation workflows.
